name: Chicago Heights (United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of purple-blue, red and purple-blue, charged with a ring of eight white stars overlapping the three stripes.
history: Chicago Heights is a city in Cook County, Illinois. The flag was adopted in 1976 (chosen in a contest to design a city emblem for the United States Bicentennial in 1976, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: ring of eight stars for the eight neighbourhoods
